service.name: org.moqui.ai.mcp.LayoutServices.modify#Blueprint
service.description: Modify a blueprint layout tree on the server

Use this tool when the user requests to add, create, or insert a new input field, form element, or data column into the active user interface layout canvas. Do not attempt to write text commands; execute this tool with the appropriate node target parameters to modify the layout structure directly.

parameter.name: targetNodeId
parameter.description: The unique ID string of the parent container element, section, or form panel inside the active layout tree where this new field should be appended.

parameter.name: label
parameter.description: The human-readable label or title text that will display next to the field in the user interface (e.g., 'Medical History').

parameter.name: encrypt
parameter.description: MUST be set to 'true' if the field captures sensitive data, medical history, or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) to comply with HIPAA guidelines.

parameter.name: activeLayoutBuffer
parameter.description: Optional incoming tree buffer passed directly by synchronous callers.

parameter.name: activeLayoutBufferId
parameter.description: Optional incoming database tracking ID passed directly by synchronous callers.
